description: This file defines a Mailer class implementing the MailerInterface, wrapping Symfony's mailer components to send email messages within the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: Mailer
classes.description: A wrapper class around Symfony's Mailer to facilitate sending emails within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mailer with a transport mechanism, creating an internal SymfonyMailer instance.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an email message, optionally with an envelope, using the internal SymfonyMailer.
